budget: CPU, small fixed architecture, validation early stopping; no test tuning
csdi_target_strategy: mix: water-only contiguous patterns and random masking
development_attempt: full case-weighted validation runs were stopped for computational cost before any CSDI test prediction; all final arms rerun with the same group-balanced rule
test_selection: first calendar and first two decision-time dangerous crossed cases for two evenly spaced eligible years per held-group station
validation_selection: at most three evenly spaced station-years per independent validation group, chosen without losses or H30 values
